paragraphs.source_en: The ultimate accolade for Monsanto's role came in a 1979 Business Week article entitled, "Cleansing the Chemical Image." "The chemical industry's movement into the imagebuilding arena," said the magazine, "was spearheaded by Monsanto Co. in 1977. Chairman John W. Hanley saw that chemicals came out the villain every time and decided it was time to do something. That year, the company spent $4.5 million on image building, and it has equaled or exceeded that amount each year since.
